overview_description.description:
eecrow is a fintech platform that combines smart contracts, escrow-based payments, and dispute resolution services to create secure business transactions between freelancers, SMEs, clients, and vendors.

Its core value proposition is reducing payment risk and improving trust in digital and cross-border business engagements. The platform automates contractual obligations through enforceable smart contracts, ensuring that payments are only released when agreed milestones or deliverables are completed.
